column3: Close to the Hebrew; “dappled, strong” is rendered “dappled horses--strong steeds.”
NKJV renders “the four winds of the heavens” as “four spirits of heaven,” and “from presenting themselves before” as “from their station before.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the strong ones” is rendered “the strong steeds,” and “they sought to go” “eager to go.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “the gift” (“Receive the gift from the captives”).
NKJV renders the plural “crowns” as “an elaborate crown.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man, Branch [is] his name” is rendered “the Man whose name is the BRANCH,” and “from under him he will sprout” “From His place He shall branch out.”
Close to the Hebrew; “majesty” is rendered “the glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “crowns” is rendered “the elaborate crown.”
Close to the Hebrew; “if you will surely listen” is rendered “if you diligently obey,” and NKJV supplies “this shall come to pass.”
